text: REST API provides programmatic access to workspace meeting notes and related data for custom integrations
quote: The Granola API provides programmatic access to your workspace's meeting notes and related data. This RESTful API enables you to integrate Granola with your existing tools

text: API lets developers pull meeting notes, transcripts, and AI-generated summaries for custom integrations
quote: The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.

text: Users can build custom AI agents that analyze call sentiment, surface recurring feedback themes, or combine meeting context with other data sources
quote: Custom AI agents - Build agents that analyze sentiment across your calls, surface recurring themes in product feedback, or combine meeting context with other data sources for deeper insights.

text: Granola MCP lets AI tools connect to meeting notes to search and find topics discussed in past meetings
quote: Connect your AI tools to your Granola meeting notes with Granola MCP. Once connected you can use this to: search through your meeting notes, find specific topics discussed in past meetings

text: Chat feature lets users ask questions across meeting notes to recall details and spot patterns across calls
quote: Chat with your meeting notes to recall meeting details, spot patterns across customer calls, and generate follow-up outputs.

text: Chat can draft and send a follow-up email, draft a Slack message, or create a Google Calendar event after a meeting
quote: Ask Chat to: draft and send a follow-up email * draft and send a Slack message * find a time and create a Google Calendar event

text: Recipes are reusable prompt templates for quickly getting insights from meeting notes without retyping questions
quote: Recipes are reusable prompt templates that help you quickly get insights from your meeting notes without typing the same questions repeatedly.

text: Users can choose or create custom summary templates for specific meeting types like 1:1s, interviews, or sales pitches
quote: While Granola's default summarisation adapts to a range of formats, you might want to choose a specific template (or set up your own!) for a specific type of call: for instance, 1:1s, interviews or sales pitches.

text: Meeting notes can be exported to CSV including title, summary, transcript, and other details
quote: Export your Granola meeting notes to CSV. Get note titles, summaries, transcripts, and details.

text: Granola connects to 8,000+ apps to automate actions after a meeting
quote: Connect Granola to 8,000+ apps and automate what happens after a meeting

text: Notes added to Granola folders automatically sync to the relevant contact, company, or deal records in HubSpot
quote: You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.

text: Transcription and generated summaries support multiple languages
quote: Granola supports multiple languages for transcription and generated meeting summaries.

text: Transcripts can be automatically deleted after a set retention period while notes remain available
quote: Granola allows you to automatically delete transcripts after a set period of time. This applies only to transcripts — your notes are not affected and will remain available.

text: Notes are private by default and are never shared with participants unless explicitly shared via link or team folder
quote: Your notes are never shared with any participants unless you share the link, or add the note to a folder in your team space.

text: Speaker tags label each participant by name in the transcript instead of generic Me/Them labels
quote: Speaker tags show each participant's name above their parts of the conversation, giving you more detailed attribution than the default Me and Them labels.

text: Mobile app lets users take AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings and, on iOS, phone calls
quote: Granola for mobile lets you take AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings (and, on iOS, phone calls).

text: Copy Link creates a unique shareable URL for meeting notes that can be sent to others
quote: Copy link will copy a unique URL link to the meeting notes, which you can send to others.

text: Granola works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and every other meeting app
quote: Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and every other meeting app.

text: Granola posts a message in the meeting chat when it starts transcribing to notify participants
quote: Granola posts a message in your meeting chat when it starts transcribing to let everyone know.

text: Users can opt out of having their data used for model training via Settings
quote: You can opt out of model training in Settings.

text: A magnifying glass icon lets users jump to the exact transcript or raw notes location a summary point came from
quote: Use the magnifying glass beside each note to see where in the transcript or raw notes the note came from

text: Workspace admins on Business/Enterprise plans can create non-expiring workspace-level API keys
quote: Workspace admins on Business and Enterprise plans can also create workspace API keys. These belong to the workspace rather than an individual user, don't expire

text: Granola captures audio directly from the user's computer instead of inviting a bot into the call
quote: Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot

text: Granola connects to the user's calendar to show upcoming meetings
quote: Granola connects to your calendar to show your upcoming meetings.
